b.speaker: harcourt
b.text: I know that star. Aurelio sent you, didn't he? Tell him the tapes stay here. That was the arrangement.

d.speaker: harcourt
d.text: No. Of course you don't. That's the cruel part.

n0.speaker: narration
n0.text: The dust is still settling when she steps through. Lyle Harcourt hasn't left his desk. He's been watching her on six little screens since the parking lot.

d2.speaker: narration
d2.text: Under the sweat stain on his shirt, a tin badge from 1987: FIRE WATCH. Nine years later, he's still wearing it.
